content:
Act as an elite Florida salt-water fishing guide, marine biologist, and tactical overland angler. Generate a comprehensive wade fishing playbook for the targeted location based on real-time environmental factors, equipment profiles, and lunar shifts.
1. ENVIRONMENTAL DATA & BERNAL ANCHORS
• Sighting Location: Operating within the {{Florida Sinking Region|*Tampa Bay Flats, Mosquito Lagoon, Charlotte Harbor, Sarasota Passes, Nature Coast Estuaries}} zone.
• Estuarine Telemetry: Current structural phase is set to {{Tidal Movement|*Incoming Flood, Outgoing Ebb, Slack High, Slack Low}} with clear water clarity classified as {{Water Clarity: Crystal Clear | Tannin/Stained, Turbid/Muddy}}.
• Solar/Lunar Window: Barometric trend is trending {{Barometric Trend|*Steady/High, Dropping Rapidly, Rising Post-Front}} under a {{Moon Phase: New Moon | Full Moon, Waxing Gibbous, Waning Crescent}} celestial alignment.
2. TARGET SPECIES & BEHAVIORAL PROFILING
• Apex Search Matrix: Prioritize foraging lane tracking for {{Target Species|*Common Snook, Red Drum, Spotted Seatrout, Tarpon, Common Snook | Redfish Mixed Flocks}}.
• Structural Alignment: Chart explicit casting patterns matching local structural boundaries, optimizing lure trajectories around {{Structure Blueprint|*Mangrove Root Cutlines, Oyster Bars, Potholes in Seagrass, Deep Channel Drop-offs}}.
3. TACTICAL GEAR & RUNTIME RIGGING
• Rod & Reel Blueprint: Deploy a {{Rod Action|*Fast Action Medium-Light, Moderate-Fast Medium}} setup spooled with a baseline running line weight of {{Braid Mainline: 15lb | 10lb, 20lb}} linked to a stealth fluorocarbon leader of {{Leader Weight: 20lb | 15lb, 30lb}}.
• Presentation Terminal Selector: Recommend the top lure or live-bait configuration assuming a current water temperature reading of {{Water Temp F: 74-78}}. Present distinct presentation options across a variety of depth columns: {{Lure Strategy|*Topwater Walk-the-Dog, Paddle Tail Soft Plastic on 1/8oz Jig, Suspending Twitchbait}}.
SAFETY DISCLAIMER: Always cross-reference local wading routes with updated navigational maps. Avoid walking blindly into soft mud channels, maintain active stingray shuffling safety protocols at all times, and strictly verify your active daily bag limits via official state wildlife registry channels before harvesting any catches.
